verses.text: How can any of you take a dispute with a neighbor to court before unjust judges instead of bringing it before God's people?
Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? If the world is to be judged by you, are you really unqualified to handle small disputes?
Don't you know we'll judge angels? How much more can we handle everyday matters?
So when you have disputes about everyday things, why appoint as judges people the church doesn't respect?
I'm saying this to make you feel ashamed. Is there really no one wise among you who can settle a dispute between fellow believers?
Instead, one believer takes another to court—and in front of unbelievers at that!
The fact that you have lawsuits against one another is already a failure. Why not accept being wronged? Why not let yourself be cheated?
But instead, you do wrong and cheat—and you do it to your own brothers and sisters.
Don't you know that people who do wrong won't inherit God's Kingdom? Don't be deceived: the sexually immoral, idol worshipers, adulterers, men who sell sex, men who have sex with men,
thieves, the greedy, drunkards, slanderers, and swindlers won't inherit God's Kingdom.
Some of you used to be like that. But you were washed clean, made holy, and made right in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
You say, ‘I'm allowed to do anything’—but not everything is helpful. ‘I'm allowed to do anything’—but I won't let anything control me.
You say, ‘Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food,’ but God will put an end to both. The body isn't meant for sexual immorality; it's meant for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.
God raised the Lord from the dead, and by his power he will raise us too.
Don't you know your bodies are parts of Christ? Should I take parts of Christ and join them to a prostitute? Absolutely not!
Don't you know that the one who joins with a prostitute becomes one body with her? Scripture says, ‘The two will become one flesh.’
But the one who joins with the Lord is one spirit with him.
Run from sexual immorality! Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against their own body.
Don't you know your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you and was given to you by God? You don't belong to yourself.
You were bought at a price. So honor God with your body and your spirit, which belong to him.
